svg.title: Nominal pedals · Overlap
svg.desc: Synthetic engineering observations of an unmeasured nominal organ model. Five aligned views show two drawbar positions, four pedal buses, two pre-control mixtures and pedal output, all 25 pedal target/contact groups and independent manual routing, then final normalized audio. Every grouped contact bit is checked. State transitions retain exact sample boundaries; signal strokes retain each time bin's observed extrema. This is not a measured instrument, source replay, phase-continuity proof or acoustic calibration.
svg.text: Synthetic engineering · nominal and unmeasured · dimensionless signals
48,000 Hz · seed 0 · 5,760 frames · 120 ms · trace schema 1 / scenario 1
Each row pairs post-event controls and contacts with the same rendered sample; source phase is retained in the CSV.
solid = held target and all 8 closed ideal contacts
* P08–P12 include disconnected c1. Its physical contact bit is checked and stays visible within the eight-contact group.
Contact grouping is valid only for the declared ideal model. Cancel and division panics retain their separate lanes.
normalized float · peak 0.12439 · strokes show observed bin extrema, not an interpolated waveform
Signal extrema retained in at most 1000 bins. State transitions are not downsampled. Coordinates round to 0.001 px.
Validation covers structure and stated field relations. No source replay, instrument authentication or physical calibration.
